from astropy.table import QTable
import astropy.units as u
import numpy as np

# Test round-trip with header_rows
lines = [
    "======= ======== ====",
    "   wave response ints",
    "     nm       ct     ",
    "float64  float32 int8",
    "======= ======== ====",
    "  350.0      1.0    1",
    "  950.0      2.0    2",
    "======= ======== ====",
]
tbl = QTable.read(lines, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name", "unit", "dtype"])
print("Wavelength:", tbl["wave"])
print("Response:", tbl["response"])
print("Ints:", tbl["ints"])
print("Wave unit:", tbl["wave"].unit)
print("Response unit:", tbl["response"].unit)
print("Wave dtype:", tbl["wave"].dtype)
print("Response dtype:", tbl["response"].dtype)
print("Ints dtype:", tbl["ints"].dtype)

# Write back
out = StringIO()
tbl.write(out, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name", "unit", "dtype"])
print("Written output:")
print(out.getvalue())

# Check if round-trip matches
assert out.getvalue().splitlines() == lines, f"Round-trip failed!"
print("Round-trip successful!")

from astropy.table import QTable, Table
import astropy.units as u
import numpy as np

tbl = QTable({'wave': [350, 950]*u.nm, 'response': [0.7, 1.2]*u.count})

tbl.write(out, format="ascii.rst")
result = out.getvalue()
print("Test 1 - Standard RST write:")
print(result)
assert "=====" in result
assert "wave" in result
assert "response" in result

# Test 2: Write with header_rows=["name", "unit"]
out = StringIO()
tbl.write(out, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name", "unit"])
result = out.getvalue()
print("Test 2 - RST write with header_rows=['name', 'unit']:")
print(result)
assert "nm" in result
assert "ct" in result

out = StringIO()
tbl.write(out, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name"])
result = out.getvalue()
print("Test 3 - RST write with header_rows=['name']:")
print(result)

# Test 4: Write with header_rows=[] (no header)
out = StringIO()
tbl.write(out, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=[])

print("Test 4 - RST write with header_rows=[]:")
